title: Emulator oracle Wario trace, version 1
description: Named WRAM and HRAM variables that Wario's movement reads or writes, recorded before the first tick (frames[0]) and after every tick (frames[t + 1] after tick t), and the level block map in SRAM with its changes. Multi-byte values are big-endian, as the game stores them; signed bytes are kept raw (0-255). ROM-derived: lives only under ignored local/captures/. Used by the native movement parity check (WL3-012).

block_rows.description: The level block map in SRAM before the first tick: 64 rows of 160 bytes (bit 7 kept; older traces have the 48 decoded rows).

block_gap_rows.description: The 16 bytes after each block-map row in its SRAM page ($a0-$af), which the level's decompressors never write, before the first tick (older traces lack them).

block_changes.description: [frame, row, column, value, seen]: the map byte that differs in frames[frame] from the frame before; `seen` (optional, older traces lack it) is the object checkpoint at which it was first seen during that frame, or 4 at the frame's end.

camera_updates.description: [frame, before, after] for every run of UpdateLevel's camera code: the variables on entry to ClearUnusedVirtualOAM, which precedes it on all three paths, and at UpdateLevel.asm_8229, where it ends (with the Hidden Figure camera at .asm_8227, its jump past it).

updates.description: [frame, before, after] for every Wario update: the variables on entry to UpdateWarioStates and on entry to UpdateObjects, which UpdateLevel calls next. `frame` is the index of the first sample taken after the update.

object_checkpoints.description: Object slots around UpdateObjects and ProcessInteractions (WL3-035): [frame, checkpoint, variables, objects, particles], where checkpoint 0 is the entry to UpdateObjects, 1 to SetWarioScreenPos (after UpdateObjects), 2 to ProcessInteractions, and 3 to DrawObjects_NoPriority (after it); variables follow `variables`, and objects is WRAM bank 1 $d000-$d162 in hex (older traces to $d15f): wObjects (8 slots of 32 bytes), wCurObj, wObjDataPointers, the objects' globals, and the hidden figure's fight's; particles is $cca0-$cce1 in hex: wParticles (4 slots of 16 bytes), wNumParticles, and wCurParticleIndex.

object_rows.description: The object map before the first tick (WL3-035): 48 rows of the 80 bytes from $b0 of each map page, one nibble a block (the even column in the high nibble).

object_changes.description: [frame, row, byte, value]: an object map byte that differs in frames[frame] from the frame before.

animation_calls.description: [frame, kind, line]: a call of UpdateRoomAnimatedTiles (kind 0) or UpdateRoomAnimatedPals (1) during the tick that frames[frame] follows, with the rLY value it read (late lines skip the animation).

golf_loops.description: [frame, loops]: a visit to the golf minigame (not ported) whose first game loop (a call of _GolfStateTable) ran during the tick that frames[frame] follows, and its number of game loops (older traces lack them).

golf_variables.description: The variables of each golf_updates entry, in order (older traces lack them); values of more than one byte are big-endian.

golf_updates.description: [frame, values, golf RAM, virtual OAM, rDIV reads]: at each game loop of the golf minigame (a call of _GolfStateTable, during the tick that frames[frame] follows), the golf_variables' values, the golf RAM in WRAMX bank 1 as hex ($d800-$d805 then $db40-$dc9b), wVirtualOAM's 160 bytes as hex, and how many div_reads came before the loop (older traces lack them, the OAM, or the count).

golf_vram.description: [golf update, VRAM bank 0, VRAM bank 1]: at every 32nd game loop of a golf visit, both VRAM banks ($8000-$9fff) as hex at the loop's start, with the index of its golf_updates entry (older traces lack them).

golf_screens.description: [golf update, screen]: the screen shown during the golf loop of that golf_updates entry (a golf_vram snapshot's loop), captured at the end of the tick it ran in: 160x144 RGB bytes, gzipped, in base64 (older traces lack them).

golf_ram.description: The golf RAM ranges of each golf_updates entry, in order (WRAM bank, address, size; older traces lack them).

animation_copies.description: [frame, line]: each 8-byte chunk UpdateRoomAnimatedTiles copied to VRAM during the tick that frames[frame] follows, with rLY when it was written (in that line's H-Blank; lines drawn before show the old tiles). Older traces lack them.

pal_writes.description: [frame, kind, line, left, source]: each palette a level wrote while its frame was drawn, one palette an H-Blank, during the tick that frames[frame] follows: kind 0 a BG palette (SetBGPals), 1 an OBJ palette (SetWarioPal); rLY when its first byte was written (lines drawn before show the old colours), the palettes left to write counting this one (B), and where its bytes come from (HL). Older traces lack them.

temple_vram.description: [frame, VRAM bank 0, VRAM bank 1]: at every 32nd Wario update in the Temple (the hidden figure's fight), both VRAM banks as hex at the update's start, during the tick that frames[frame] follows. Older traces lack them.

temple_screens.description: [frame, screen]: the screen shown during the tick of a temple_vram snapshot's frame, captured at its end: 160x144 RGB bytes, gzipped, in base64. Older traces lack them.

div_reads.description: [frame, checkpoints, bank, address, value]: a read of rDIV (the hardware timer) during the tick that frames[frame] follows, after `checkpoints` object checkpoints, hooked at the instruction after the read, in the order the game made them; with bank 255, ProcessBlock's read of a block byte outside the recorded map rows (address: where it read).
